title: Gladiators
objective: After this level you can separate the reality of gladiator fights from popular myth.
summary: Gladiator fights began as funeral games. Most fighters were enslaved or condemned, fought in set types, and were often spared.

cards.headline: Thumbs down meant death? Probably not the way the movies show it.
cards.body: The real arena was stranger, and often less deadly, than the film version.

cards.headline: Who fought
cards.body: Gladiator fights probably began as funeral games to honor the dead, first recorded in Rome in 264 BCE. So Rome’s bloodiest show started as a way to mourn. Most gladiators were enslaved people, prisoners of war or condemned criminals. But some free men volunteered. Yes, a few people chose this job.

cards.headline: How they fought
cards.body: Gladiators fought in types with set equipment. The retiarius, armed with a net and trident, faced the helmeted secutor: a matchup, not a brawl. And gladiators were expensive to train, so many fights did not end in death. A beaten fighter could be spared. Nobody wants to lose an expensive investment in one afternoon.

cards.fact: No one knows exactly what the thumb meant.
cards.context: Roman writers mention a “turned thumb” deciding a gladiator’s fate, but its exact meaning is unknown. So when a movie emperor jabs his thumb down with total confidence, he knows more than historians do.

cards.headline: Gladiators: unmasked
learned: Most gladiators were enslaved or condemned

questions.prompt: How did gladiator fights probably begin?

options.label: As funeral games honoring the dead

questions.explanation: The first recorded fights in Rome, in 264 BCE, were funeral games.

questions.prompt: Why were many defeated gladiators spared?

options.label: Killing in the arena was illegal

questions.explanation: A trained gladiator was a costly investment, so many beaten fighters lived to fight again.

questions.prompt: From Level 34: Spartacus escaped from a gladiator school in which town?

options.label: Pompeii
options.rationale: It was a different town nearby.
